{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled IPC; adds interfaces::Snapshot and extends interfaces::Node to expose assumeutxo loading across process boundaries.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #N",
      "rationale": "Exposes assumeutxo loading via interfaces::Node to directly unblock GUI snapshot loading PRs in bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488. Having concrete consumers waiting for interface expansion places this squarely in strategic progress for multiprocess/GUI separation."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/notifications_interface.h to add progress notifications for snapshot loading.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a snapshot progress callback method to the kernel notifications interface. While it broadens the boundary notification capabilities, it is an incremental addition to support the outer interface rather than core kernel extraction."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures, policy, or fee estimation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no connection to transaction acceptance, eviction, or mempool policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/blockchain.cpp, refactoring loadtxoutset and changing its returned error codes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Refactors loadtxoutset to invoke the new snapshot interface and alters error reporting on file-open or parsing failures to RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR. It modifies RPC caller contract behavior, though primarily as a downstream effect of the interface extraction."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp only to dispatch progress notification signals during snapshot loading.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively alter validation rules, UTXO set management, or assumeutxo integrity logic; the validation edits merely dispatch notification events."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
